note: Adds two entity_reference field widgets - erviews_options_select (Select list) and erviews_options_buttons (Check boxes/radio buttons) - that render a View-backed entity-reference field using the View's row output. No settings page, permission, service, or plugin type. The only persistent state is the widget 'type' of a field's component in a bundle's entity_form_display config. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads which widget a field uses; execution switches a field's form-display widget to one of the module's widgets, verified against the live entity_form_display. Fixtures create/remove their own namespaced field_erv_* fields on node.article.

evals.prompt: I want an entity-reference field that uses a View for its allowed values to show up as a drop-down or as radio buttons instead of autocomplete. What does the entity_reference_views_select module give me and what are the widget ids?
evals.expected_output: It adds two field widgets: erviews_options_select ('Entity Reference Views Select list') and erviews_options_buttons ('Entity Reference Views Check boxes/radio buttons'), for entity_reference fields whose reference method is a View.

evals.prompt: How do I actually enable an entity_reference_views_select widget for a field, and is there a settings page for it?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page. Set the field's reference method to a View, then on the bundle's Manage form display choose the 'Entity Reference Views Select list' or 'Check boxes/radio buttons' widget. The choice is stored as the widget type on the field's component in the entity_form_display config.

evals.prompt: In the entity_reference_views_select widgets, what is used as each option's label, and what happens if the field is not actually using a View as its reference method?
evals.expected_output: When the field handler is 'views' the widget executes the View and renders each result row (via the View's row plugin) as the option label, keyed by entity id. If the handler is not a View, the widgets fall back to a standard select/checkbox.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an entity-reference field configured to use one of the entity_reference_views_select widgets. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of the widget used by field_erv_known.
evals.expected_output: field_erv_known uses the erviews_options_select widget in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two entity-reference fields, field_erv_sel and field_erv_btn, each using an entity_reference_views_select widget. Inspect the live form display and tell me which field renders its options as checkboxes/radio buttons.
evals.expected_output: field_erv_btn uses the erviews_options_buttons (Check boxes/radio buttons) widget, whereas field_erv_sel uses erviews_options_select.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity-reference field field_erv_htask that currently uses the autocomplete widget. Using the entity_reference_views_select module, change its default form-display widget to the 'Entity Reference Views Select list' widget, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_erv_htask component in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default to type erviews_options_select, e.g. $fd->setComponent('field_erv_htask', ['type'=>'erviews_options_select','region'=>'content'])->save();

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an entity-reference field field_erv_btask that currently uses the autocomplete widget. Using the entity_reference_views_select module, change its default form-display widget to the 'Entity Reference Views Check boxes/radio buttons' widget, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_erv_btask component in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default to type erviews_options_buttons, e.g. $fd->setComponent('field_erv_btask', ['type'=>'erviews_options_buttons','region'=>'content'])->save();
